name: 576-6912f MassLink™ with FlexRibbon® Cable
description: MassLink™ with FlexRibbon® technology features an ultracompact design for outside-plant cables and can accommodate up to 6,912 bend-insensitive fibers. This efficient configuration uses FlexRibbon technology, which rolls and packs ribbons into small-diameter sub-units with 144 or 288 fibers. Despite the high packing density, these 200 µm fiber ribbons maintain the benefits of mass fusion splicing.
specs: FlexRibbons are rolled up into compact 144- to 288-fiber sub-units; Significantly smaller-diameter, lighter-weight cables; Easier installation and the use of smaller ducts; Uses standard 200 ?m coated bend-insensitive fiber (ITU G657.A2)

name: 144-192f MicroFlex™ with FlexRibbon® Cable
description: Spinel's MicroFlex™ cables are designed for optimal jetting performance in underground microduct installations or for jetting directly over existing cables. The FlexRibbon® technology used in these cables delivers the advantages of mass-fusion splicing while maintaining a compact diameter, which is crucial for applications requiring a smaller cable size. With 250?m fiber, splicing is straightforward.
specs: Reduced size and weight for installation in microduct; Optimized for jetted microduct installations; Defer CAPEX by maximizing duct utilization; Quick installation – long lengths and high speeds; Allow use of ducts already containing cable;

name: ResiLink™ Mini-Flat Drop Dielectric Cable
description: The ResiLink™ Mini-Flat Drop Dielectric or Toneable Cable offers superior versatility and protection for broadband and access network installations. Its compact, all-dielectric or optional tone wire designs provide flexibility, durability, and ease of handling for aerial, duct, and direct burial applications. Engineered to meet the highest performance standards, this flat drop fiber optic cable ensures reliable connectivity with minimal maintenance, supporting a wide range of FTTH and telecom deployments.
specs: ~20% reduced cross-section surface area; +50% weight reduction; Flexible, lightweight, and kink-resistant construction; Telcordia GR-20 and ICEA 717 standards

name: ResiLink™ All-Dielectric Flat Drop Cable (1-24 Fibers)
description: Spinel’s ResiLink™ All-Dielectric Flat (ADF) Drop is an all-dielectric, outside-plant-rated cable accommodating 1 to 24 bend-insensitive single-mode fibers. This small-profile, rugged design features two dielectric-strength elements on either side of the cable, making it a strong yet flexible solution for fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) drop applications.
specs: Compact, flat drop design; Excellent tensile and crush resistance; HDPE outer sheath; Rated for aerial self-support, duct; Direct burial drop cable installations; Spans up to 450 feet in NESC Light environments; Compliant with ANSI, ICEA, RUS, Telcordia, and TIA standards

name: ResiLink™ Toneable Flat Drop Cable (1-24 Fibers)
description: Toneable flat drop cable suitable for duct or underground applications, available with 1 to 24 fibers. The ResiLink™ Toneable Flat Drop Cable is engineered for durability, flexibility, and easy identification in access network installations.
specs: Telcordia GR-20 and ICEA 717 standards; Durable high-density polyethylene (HDPE) jacket; Dual dielectric strength members; Excellent aerial and duct performance; Crush-resistant and suitable for direct burial.

name: Long Span ADSS Cable
description: Spinel's Long Span ADSS (All-Dielectric Self-Supporting) version provides reliable self-support for distances up to 2,600 feet (800 meters). Each Long Span ADSS cable is custom-engineered for optimal placement on utility towers. It is designed to operate effectively under full weather loads, ensuring safe, dependable, and long-lasting performance.
specs: Designs span distances up to 2,600’ (800m); Higher count designs utilize 24 fibers per tube; Ripcord speeds cable entry & outer jacket removal; Swellable binders speed cable preparation; Available bend-insensitive single-mode fiber; 2.6 mm tube with 12 fibers per tube; 3.0 mm tube with 24 fibers per tube

name: Dry FusionLink™ Armored RICT Cable
description: Spinel's Dry FusionLink™ Armored Cable features a compact design with an easily removable ribbon matrix, precise ribbon geometry, a flexible ribbon tube, and advanced dry water-blocking technology. Additionally, it comes equipped with ezPrep® Corrugated Steel Armor and is available in both uncoupled and coupled designs.
specs: Telcordia GR-20 & ICEA 640; EIA/TIA-455 series FOTPs; Complies with RUS PE-90; Rapid cable preparation and termination;

name: Dry FusionLink™ RICT Cable
description: FusionLink™ Dry Flat-Ribbon Central Tube Cable is a leading design in the ribbon cable industry, offering numerous advantages. This cable incorporates dry-tube technology and features both coupled and uncoupled ribbon designs, making it compatible with standard fiber management systems.
specs: RDUP listed (tested in accordance with PE-90); Telcordia GR-20 & ICEA 640; EIA/ TIA-455 series FOTPs; Mid-span access is safer and easier; Rapid cable preparation and termination; Superior kink resistance; Increased flexibility; Allows for ease of stripping and fiber breakout; Improves mid-span strippability
